tertiary.$description: Kit contract 2.0.0: tertiary text for slide footers, legal lines, slide numbers and source lines (Owner ruling 1 and ruling 11, 2026-10-09). Not in kit-contract.css, which keeps the old 24 roles.

surface.$description: Kit contract: card and panel background (Owner ruling 9, 2026-10-09).

surface-2.$description: Kit contract: recessed or group background.

accent.$description: Kit contract: primary action, links and identifiers; navy (ADR-0003).

accent-ink.$description: Kit contract: text on accent fills, and on every state fill the kit renderers draw.

warning.$description: Kit contract: caution state. Warning strong, not the fill, because kit renderers put white text on it (Owner ruling 5, 2026-10-09).

font-body.$description: Kit contract: body and reading text, Newsreader (Owner ruling 10, 2026-10-09).

font-heading.$description: Kit contract: titles, headings, badges and buttons, Outfit (Owner ruling 10, 2026-10-09).

font-mono.$description: Kit contract: identifiers, codes and figures, Geist Mono (Owner ruling 10, 2026-10-09).

title-size.$description: Kit contract: view and slide title size, the section title size.

shell-max.$description: Kit contract: maximum width of a kit view. Kit default kept; no MedQuantis value for wide boards yet (owner decision pending).

node-radius.$description: Kit contract: diagram node radius (Owner ruling 3, 2026-10-09).

shadow.$description: Kit contract: card elevation, the MedQuantis small shadow (owner decision, 2026-10-10).

chart-1.$description: Kit contract: first series, darkest; series 1 of the ordered palette (guidelines/charts.md, The ordered palette).

chart-2.$description: Kit contract: second series; series 2 of the ordered palette (guidelines/charts.md).

chart-3.$description: Kit contract: third series; series 3 of the ordered palette, below 3:1 on the page, so label or outline its marks (guidelines/charts.md).

chart-4.$description: Kit contract: fourth series; series 4 of the ordered palette, below 3:1 on the page (guidelines/charts.md).

chart-rest.$description: Kit contract: every series past the fourth, the remainder fill grouped as Other (guidelines/charts.md, never more than four series).

chart-axis.$description: Kit contract: axis lines and ticks, non-text (guidelines/charts.md, Marks).

chart-grid.$description: Kit contract: the one 1 px baseline; MedQuantis draws no background grid (guidelines/charts.md, Marks).

chart-highlight.$description: Kit contract: the highlighted mark is series 1, every other item in series 3 (guidelines/charts.md, Highlight on grey).

font-size-xs.$description: Kit contract: smallest text, 11 px, the floor for any text (guidelines/typography.md).

font-size-sm.$description: Kit contract: small text, the 13 px label size.

font-size-md.$description: Kit contract: body text size, 16.5 px on screen.

font-size-lg.$description: Kit contract: large text, the 20 px subsection title.

font-size-xl.$description: Kit contract: display text, the 56 px hero title (css/base.css .mq-display).

line-height-body.$description: Kit contract: body line height, 1.55 (owner 2026-10-15, Plan-0002).

line-height-tight.$description: Kit contract: heading line height, 1.15 (owner 2026-10-15, Plan-0002).

font-weight-bold.$description: Kit contract: the heading weight, Outfit 500; MedQuantis headings never use 700 (Owner ruling 4, 2026-10-09).

space-xs.$description: Kit contract: extra-small spacing, 4 px, step 1 of the 4 and 8 px scale.

space-xl.$description: Kit contract: extra-large spacing, 48 px, the step after space-lg (32 px).

radius-sm.$description: Kit contract: small corner radius, 3 px (Owner ruling 3, 2026-10-09).

radius-pill.$description: Kit contract: pill corner radius capped at the 6 px maximum, because MedQuantis draws no pill shapes (Owner ruling 3, 2026-10-09).

doc-page-bg.$description: Kit contract: the paper sheet of a paginated document, the canvas colour of every document page (Owner ruling 9, 2026-10-09; guidelines/colour.md, Neutrals).

doc-text-size.$description: Kit contract: document body text, the 16.5 px body size that mq-doc sets on an A4 mq-page (guidelines/typography.md, Roles and sizes; the A4 print column is not yet a token).

doc-rule.$description: Kit contract: the rule between document sections, the border and divider colour (guidelines/colour.md, Neutrals).

slide-bg.$description: Kit contract: slide background, the canvas colour of every document page, slides included (Owner ruling 9, 2026-10-09; guidelines/colour.md, Neutrals).

slide-fg.$description: Kit contract: slide text colour, primary text (guidelines/colour.md, Neutrals).

slide-padding.$description: Kit contract: slide inner padding, the 72 px side margins of the slide canvas (guidelines/layout.md, Media).

slide-width.$description: Kit contract: slide canvas width, 1280 px, as css/slide.css (guidelines/layout.md, Media).

slide-height.$description: Kit contract: slide canvas height, 720 px, as css/slide.css (guidelines/layout.md, Media).

print-bg.$description: Kit contract: printed page background, the canvas colour; the desk never reaches paper (Owner ruling 9, 2026-10-09; guidelines/layout.md, Print and PDF).

print-margin.$description: Kit contract: printed page margin, 48 px top and bottom and 72 px at the sides, the padding of mq-page in css/print.css (guidelines/layout.md, Widths and spacing).

print-page-size.$description: Kit contract: printed page size, A4, 210 by 297 mm (guidelines/layout.md, Media). A named size, as the kit's print chrome reads it.

print-breaking.$description: Kit contract: the accent of breaking changes in printed reports, navy, because documents are navy only and breaking changes read by their words and a navy rule, never a status hue (ADR-0004; guidelines/colour.md, The medium split).

brand-logo-on-light.$description: Kit contract: the wordmark for light backgrounds, a package export path written as url() (guidelines/brand.md, Wordmark).

brand-logo-on-dark.$description: Kit contract: the wordmark for navy backgrounds, a package export path written as url() (guidelines/brand.md, Wordmark).

brand-mark.$description: Kit contract: the monogram, the compact mark, a package export path written as url() (guidelines/brand.md, Monogram and favicon).

brand-legal.$description: Kit contract: the legal line as a CSS string. Its value is read at build time from guidelines/brand.md, section Legal line, the one written source (build/guidelines.mjs legalLine).
